title: Junior Software Developer
jdText:
Maple Ledger builds bookkeeping software for small businesses across Canada. About 120 people, most of them in Toronto.

This role is open to new grads and developers with 0-2 years of experience. You will join the invoicing team and ship to production in your first month.

What you'll do
- Build invoice and payment screens in React and TypeScript
- Write Node.js services that talk to PostgreSQL
- Review pull requests and pair with a mentor every week

What you need
- A degree in computer science or similar, or equivalent projects
- Comfort with JavaScript or TypeScript
- Some experience with React and SQL from school, work or projects

Nice to have
- Experience with Next.js or GraphQL
- Interest in small business finance

Compensation: CA$70,000 to CA$82,000 a year plus benefits
